profile_text.body:
Pony AI Inc. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou that trades under the ticker PONY and is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001969302. According to its own site, it describes itself as a global autonomous driving technology company founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley. The company says it is developing autonomous driving technology across three business units: Robotaxi, Robotruck, and Personally Owned Vehicles (POV), built around a core technology it calls a "virtual driver."

The site states that Pony.ai has secured licenses and credentials to test and operate autonomous driving vehicles in multiple locations worldwide, and that its autonomous vehicles had traveled over 32 million kilometers (over 13 million miles) on urban roads and highways as of April 2024. It describes accumulating millions of kilometers in autonomous road testing in complex scenarios, including difficult weather and road conditions, and says it aims to deliver autonomous driving systems at scale.

The held facts add no litigation, no tracked products, and no MCP servers for the company. Its public-company status rests on its SEC registration and its PONY ticker.
